description: This file defines an interface, IGrainActivator, for creating and disposing grain instances within the Orleans runtime. It specifies method signatures for creating a new grain instance and disposing an existing one based on a grain context.

classes.name: IGrainActivator
classes.description: Interface for activating and disposing grain instances, facilitating dependency injection and lifecycle management within Orleans.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new grain instance given a grain context.

methods.name: DisposeInstance
methods.description: Disposes of a grain instance associated with a given grain context, returning a ValueTask.
